title: Postcard Collection Catalog Completion
dataSources: Photo archives (`memory:takeout`), journal OCR (`memory:journal`), postcard records (`memory:postcard`), memory linking (`memory:photo`), archive checks (`memory:ops`).
app: Life-logging and memory telemetry — Google Photos Takeout archives, journal OCR queues, and postcard collection logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=memory:postcard collection_name=* catalogued=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(catalogued="yes",1,0))) as matched by collection_name
| eval a_catalogued_postcard_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_catalogued_postcard_pct
description: Measures the percentage of postcard records that end with a catalogued postcard by collection.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which collection are helping or hurting postcard records.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a catalogued postcard` on `memory:postcard` events and summarize the hit rate by `collection_name`.
visualization: Table of collection with percentage of postcard records ending with a catalogued postcard.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how often a catalogued postcard happens for each collection so you can see where postcard records go smoothly or get stuck.
